title: Ordinary completed-coefficient direct image
statement: For every scheme morphism f the completed coefficient map is the unique ring-sheaf map to the geometric direct image whose composite with each finite completed coefficient projection is the corresponding constant coefficient map. sfCompletedModuleDirectImage is actual SheafOfModules.pushforward along that map, on the unrestricted scalarReductionSource. Its additivity is sectionwise. This ordinary construction does not involve an integral constructible category, pull-completion comparison, or compact-support realization.
